# umami_config (Data Source)

Server settings of the Umami instance, from its environment variables. Useful for building the tracking script URL when `TRACKER_SCRIPT_NAME` renames it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "umami_config" "server" {}

resource "umami_website" "app" {
  name   = "Example app"
  domain = "app.example.com"
}

output "tracking_code" {
  value = "<script defer src=\"https://analytics.example.com/${data.umami_config.server.tracker_script_name}\" data-website-id=\"${umami_website.app.id}\"></script>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `cloud_mode` (Boolean) Whether the instance runs in cloud mode (`CLOUD_MODE`).
- `favicon_url` (String) Favicon service URL (`FAVICON_URL`), if set.
- `links_url` (String) Base URL of tracked links (`LINKS_URL`), if set. Otherwise links are served at `<umami url>/q/<slug>`.
- `pixels_url` (String) Base URL of tracking pixels (`PIXELS_URL`), if set. Otherwise pixels are served at `<umami url>/p/<slug>`.
- `private_mode` (Boolean) Whether private mode is on (`PRIVATE_MODE`).
- `session_deletion_enabled` (Boolean) Whether individual sessions can be deleted, which needs a relational database without ClickHouse.
- `telemetry_disabled` (Boolean) Whether telemetry is turned off (`DISABLE_TELEMETRY`).
- `tracker_script_name` (String) Name of the tracking script, as used in the tracking code the Umami UI shows: the first of `tracker_script_names`, or `script.js`.
- `tracker_script_names` (List of String) Custom names the tracking script is served under (`TRACKER_SCRIPT_NAME`). Empty when unset.
- `updates_disabled` (Boolean) Whether update checks are turned off (`DISABLE_UPDATES`).
